first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Blue Sky
entities.identification: A large expanse of Blue Sky beyond the horizon, with a lighter color near the horizon.

entities.name: Dry Grassland
entities.identification: An open, light yellowish-brown ground surface, with alternating short grass, bare soil, and coarse textures of varying lightness.

entities.name: Scattered Trees and Shrubs
entities.identification: Scattered clump-shaped crowns on the grassland, ranging in color from yellowish green-brown and light brown to dark brown.

entities.name: Dirt Road and Linear Track
entities.identification: A brown, band-shaped dirt road crossing the grassland and dark linear ruts extending along the road.

entities.name: Curved Ground Mark
entities.identification: Groups of dark, curved ruts on the ground surface, with nested or intersecting arc-shaped lines in the more complete areas.

entities.name: Distant Long, Narrow Water Surface
entities.identification: A smooth, blue-gray band-shaped water surface on the far side of the grassland, adjacent to a light-colored shoreline.

entities.name: Thin Light-Colored Strip at the Edge of the Frame
entities.identification: A thin, elongated, light whitish outline extending into frame 31 from the bottom edge in the lower-left area, with a distinct bend and variations in width.
